findings.mechanism: 01-isolation-levels – the function reads the wallet row then writes without SELECT FOR UPDATE or an atomic UPDATE, so under READ COMMITTED concurrent writers can lose updates, violating the balance invariant.
findings.remediation: Use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (or an atomic UPDATE statement) on the wallet row before checking and updating, or run the transaction at SERIALIZABLE isolation with proper retry logic.
findings.arithmetic: B=100 (initial balance), A=10 (debit amount), N=5 concurrent writers; under READ COMMITTED without row locking only one debit persists, so final_balance = B - A = 90.

prediction.condition: 5 concurrent debit writers each amount=10 on initial balance=100

findings.arithmetic: B=100 (initial balance), A=10 (credit amount), N=5 concurrent writers; under READ COMMITTED without row locking only one credit persists, so final_balance = B + A = 110.
